description: A chief legal officer must approve the company's written response to a state attorney general's inquiry into auto-renewal cancellation practices and finalize the corrective-action and customer-refund terms, with input from consumer regulatory counsel and the customer operations liaison.

shared_context.S1: The state attorney general's office is investigating whether the company's auto-renewal cancellation process may have been confusing to consumers.
shared_context.S2: The company currently uses a two-step cancellation process and has not yet made any admission of liability.
shared_context.S3: The attorney general's office has requested a written response describing the company's position and any corrective measures.
shared_context.S4: Maya Chen gives final approval to the response, and the firm's routine pre-filing review requires consumer regulatory counsel and customer operations to report relevant legal and operational information before approval.

PF1.text: During a call after the response draft was circulated, the attorney general's staff indicated that an acceptable resolution would require one-click cancellation, a confirmation sent within 24 hours, and an express no-admission-of-liability provision; Daniel captured this in his call notes but has not yet incorporated it into the draft.

PF2.text: Tara reviewed the cancellation and billing logs this morning and reconciled exactly 317 customers who were charged after attempting cancellation, with total customer refunds of exactly $48,600; the reconciliation was completed after the operational figures in the draft were prepared.

acceptance_conditions: The response must commit to one-click cancellation.
The response must commit to sending cancellation confirmation within exactly 24 hours.
The response must expressly avoid admitting liability.
The response must provide refunds to exactly 317 customers.
The total refund amount must be exactly $48,600.
The settlement package must contain a commitment implementing a corrective measure, including one-click cancellation or another corrective action required by the attorney general's staff.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['corrective_measure', 'corrective_action', 'regulatory_response', 'operational_commitment'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The attorney general's staff guidance changes the response from a generic explanation of the existing process to one-click cancellation, exactly 24-hour confirmation, an express no-admission position, and a corrective-action commitment.
The reconciled operational review changes the customer-remediation terms from unspecified refunds to exactly 317 affected customers receiving exactly $48,600 in total refunds.
